items.source: Creates a new IntoLayerSpec that will control the content of the given layer.
items.translation: 创建一个新的IntoLayerSpec，它将控制给定层的内容。

items.source:
Adds patterns that control the content that is included in the layer. If no
includes are specified then all content is included. If includes are specified
then content must match an inclusion and not match any exclusions to be
included.
items.translation: 添加用于控制包含在层中的内容的模式。如果未指定任何包含项，则所有内容都会被包含。如果指定了包含项，则内容必须匹配某个包含项且不匹配任何排除项才会被包含。

items.source:
Adds patterns that control the content that is excluded from the layer. If no
excludes a specified no content is excluded. If exclusions are specified then
any content that matches an exclusion will be excluded irrespective of whether
it matches an include.
items.translation: 添加用于控制从图层中排除内容的模式。如果未指定任何排除项，则不会排除任何内容。如果指定了排除项，则任何匹配排除项的内容都将被排除，无论其是否匹配包含项。

items.source: Spec that controls the content that should be part of a particular layer.
items.translation: 控制特定层应包含内容的规范。

items.source: Adds patterns that control the content that is excluded from the layer.
items.translation: 添加用于控制从图层中排除的内容的模式。

items.source: Adds patterns that control the content that is included in the layer.
items.translation: 添加用于控制包含在图层中的内容的模式。

items.source: Madhura Bhave, Scott Frederick, Phillip Webb
items.translation: Madhura Bhave, Scott Frederick, Phillip Webb
